plate_comment: Sets engine_retarder_allowed_state once per pass from the enter / exit conditions (oil temperature, engine speed, boost, fueling by governor, the coolant at idle / PTO, the torque converter lockup) and the driver conditions (pedal, clutch, service_brake_recently_applied_flag): NONE, OVERRIDE_ONLY, or OVERRIDE_OR_NON_OVERRIDE (then engine_retarder_non_override_command_percent restarts at 101); also engine_retarder_immediate_brake_flag and the command level of the two previous passes (was cm848_updateEngineRetarderEnableState) | earlier note: Evaluates the engine retarder (exhaust brake) enable conditions once per pass and sets engine_retarder_enable_state: 0 = not wanted or exit condition, 1 = wanted but held off by the pedal, clutch or service brake conditions, 2 = enabled (then engine_retarder_limit_percent restarts at 101 = no limit). It uses the service brake switch with a release delay (service_brake_delayed_active_flag), the torque converter lockup state (tc_lockup_disengage_state), oil temperature, engine speed, boost, fuel demand and governor mode thresholds; it also keeps the arbitrated request of the two previous passes (was cm848_processProtectionSystemBit3).

Sets engine_retarder_command_percent and engine_retarder_command_source: 0 / NONE when the allowed state is NONE, or OVERRIDE_ONLY without an override; the override command with an override; the non-override command when the allowed state is OVERRIDE_OR_NON_OVERRIDE without one. Skipped while engine_retarder_command_tool_override_flag is set (was cm848_selectEngineRetarderRequest) | earlier note: Selects the final engine retarder request percent engine_retarder_arbitrated_request_percent and its source code engine_retarder_request_source_code (ERC1 SPN 900 mapping): 0 when the enable state is 0, or 1 with no TSC1 request; with enable state 2 and no TSC1 request the smallest limit engine_retarder_limit_percent and its limit source code; with a TSC1 torque request that request and its code. Skipped while engine_retarder_request_arbitration_inhibit_flag (constant 0 in this build) is set (was cm848_processTemperatureCompensationMode).
